The '''Aralia system''',<ref name="Day">{{JournalCite|6|To Fight Another Day|reprint=1}}</ref> also called the '''Andron system''',<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Antemeridian sector/Legends|Antemeridian sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aralia/Legends|Aralia]].<ref name="GG4" />
